## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The PR describes `--json` with no path being used alongside `--junit`, but that fails when `--json` comes first. This needs fixing before the optional destination works as the PR description says.

## Changes
The pull request moves the `--junit` assignment so it happens before the index advances. It adds a `--json` option that defaults to `results.json` when no path follows it, and a `write_reports` helper that writes each parsed report to its destination. It also adds `tests/test_cli.py`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Stop `--json` from consuming the next flag as its path — `parse_args(["--json", "--junit", "x.xml"])` stores `"--junit"` as the JSON path, then raises `ValueError("unknown option: x.xml")`. Line 15 only checks that another argument exists. It does not check whether that argument starts with `--`, which the `--junit` branch at line 7 does. — Users who put `--json` before `--junit` get a misleading unknown-option error and cannot use the default JSON destination together with `--junit`. — Fix: Use the default unless `args[i + 1]` exists and does not start with `--`, then add this order to `test_json_default_and_explicit_path`.
